evidence_boundaries: Successful telemetry receipt is observable; backend retention, aggregation and customer metric publication are not established by empty HTTP responses.
No CloudWatch namespace or metric is invented or queried without a documented telemetry mapping.
Bounded audit non-observation is not proof of nonlogging.
The documented empty success response was native HTTP200 with literal JSON body {} in this capture.

The first attempt waited60 seconds after StartLogging but neither telemetry nor positive X-Ray controls appeared in its bounded audit window; this is not nonlogging evidence. The second attempt waited for request-correlated GetGroups management records before telemetry calls.

CloudTrail exposes admitted telemetry request fields as AWS::XRay::Trace Data events; it is the observed downstream effect. No telemetry retrieval API, retention policy or customer CloudWatch metric mapping is established.
Boundary probes are signed raw requests, not a claim that the Go SDK can construct out-of-range integer fields. CloudTrail confirms fractional counter truncation and positive int32 saturation.

Two uniquely owned positive-control traces were uploaded across the attempts. X-Ray exposes no trace deletion operation; all mutable owned group/role/trail/bucket resources and delivered S3 logs were deleted and deletion checked.

Fresh replayable STS session workflow was captured after trail cleanup. Its allow/deny wire observations are not claimed to have new audit delivery. Original request-correlated role allow/deny events remain in unsequenced_session_evidence because their original AssumeRole calls lacked request timing metadata.

import ast, json, os, re, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts/aws'))
from aws_cli import run,result
path=Path('testdata/aws/xray/telemetry.json'); cap=json.loads(path.read_text())
env=dict(os.environ,AWS_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1',AWS_PAGER='')
bucket=cap['resources']['bucket']
assert bucket.startswith(cap['owner_token']+'-')
def request(label,op,params):
    started=time.time_ns()//1000000
    proc=run('s3api',op,params,env,options=['--debug','--no-paginate','--cli-connect-timeout','10','--cli-read-timeout','30'],timeout=50)
    res=result(proc,debug=True); headers={}; raw=''
    for line in proc.stderr.splitlines():
        if 'Response headers: ' in line:
            try: headers=ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers: ',1)[1])
            except (ValueError,SyntaxError): pass
        if line.startswith(("b'",'b"')):
            try:
                body=ast.literal_eval(line)
                if isinstance(body,bytes): raw=body.decode('utf-8')
            except (ValueError,SyntaxError,UnicodeDecodeError): pass
    res['request_id']=next((v for k,v in headers.items() if k.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid','x-amzn-request-id','x-amz-request-id')),None)
    cap['cleanup']['observations'].append({'label':label,'service':'s3api','operation':op,'region':'us-west-2','caller_account':cap['caller_account'],'actor_arn':cap['identity']['Arn'],'input':params,'request_started_ms':started,'response_observed_ms':time.time_ns()//1000000,'result':res,'raw_response_body':raw,'raw_response_headers':headers,'raw_request_path':None})
    print(label+': '+res['code'],flush=True)
    return res
for attempt in range(6):
    observed=request('verify-owned-bucket-absent-delayed-'+str(attempt),'list-objects-v2',{'Bucket':bucket,'MaxKeys':1000})
    if observed['code']=='NoSuchBucket':
        cap['cleanup']['remaining_owned_resources']['bucket']=False
        break
    if observed['code']!='Success': raise RuntimeError('Unexpected cleanup verification result')
    objects=[{'Key':item['Key']} for item in observed['output'].get('Contents',[])]
    if objects: request('delete-late-owned-objects-'+str(attempt),'delete-objects',{'Bucket':bucket,'Delete':{'Objects':objects,'Quiet':True}})
    request('repeat-owned-bucket-delete-'+str(attempt),'delete-bucket',{'Bucket':bucket})
    time.sleep(5)
cap['cleanup']['verified_complete']=not any(cap['cleanup']['remaining_owned_resources'].values())
assert cap['cleanup']['verified_complete']
# Preserve first attempt independently; its startup-window observations must not
# replay as resources still present during the later readiness-confirmed run.
cut=next(i for i,o in enumerate(cap['observations']) if o['label']=='create-owned-bucket' and o['input']['Bucket']==bucket)
cap['prior_runs'][0]['observations']=cap['observations'][:cut]
cap['observations']=cap['observations'][cut:]
cap['prior_runs'][0]['iam_sessions']=[s for s in cap['iam_sessions'] if cap['prior_runs'][0]['owner_token'] in s['assumed_role_user']['Arn']]
cap['iam_sessions']=[s for s in cap['iam_sessions'] if cap['owner_token'] in s['assumed_role_user']['Arn']]
cap['cleanup_verification']={k:v for k,v in cap['cleanup'].items() if k!='observations'}
cap['cleanup']=cap['cleanup']['observations']
cap['audit']['xray_events']=[item['event'] for item in cap['audit']['records'] if item['event']['eventSource']=='xray.amazonaws.com']
for run_data in cap['prior_runs']:
    run_data['cleanup_verification']={k:v for k,v in run_data['cleanup'].items() if k!='observations'}
    run_data['cleanup']=run_data['cleanup']['observations']
    run_data['audit']['xray_events']=[item['event'] for item in run_data['audit']['records'] if item['event']['eventSource']=='xray.amazonaws.com']
    for o in run_data['observations']+run_data['cleanup']: o['operation']=re.sub(r'(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])','-',o['operation']).lower()
cap['sources'].extend([{'url':'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/api/API_BackendConnectionErrors.html','contract':'Six optional integer backend connection error counters.'},{'url':'https://github.com/aws/aws-xray-daemon/blob/c742f4f0248513bdb6f54f1ccb8db809a8939a9e/pkg/telemetry/telemetry.go','revision':'c742f4f0248513bdb6f54f1ccb8db809a8939a9e','release':'v3.7.0','contract':'60-second health counter rotation, ten records per daemon request, thirty buffered records; health publication starts after segments received. These daemon limits are not API batch limits.'}])
cap['evidence_boundaries'].extend(['The documented empty success response was native HTTP200 with literal JSON body {} in this capture.','The first attempt waited60 seconds after StartLogging but neither telemetry nor positive X-Ray controls appeared in its bounded audit window; this is not nonlogging evidence. The second attempt waited for request-correlated GetGroups management records before telemetry calls.','CloudTrail exposes admitted telemetry request fields as AWS::XRay::Trace Data events; it is the observed downstream effect. No telemetry retrieval API, retention policy or customer CloudWatch metric mapping is established.','Boundary probes are signed raw requests, not a claim that the Go SDK can construct out-of-range integer fields. CloudTrail confirms fractional counter truncation and positive int32 saturation.','Two uniquely owned positive-control traces were uploaded across the attempts. X-Ray exposes no trace deletion operation; all mutable owned group/role/trail/bucket resources and delivered S3 logs were deleted and deletion checked.'])
telemetry_ids={o['result']['request_id']:o['label'] for o in cap['observations'] if o['operation']=='put-telemetry-records'}
logged={e['requestID'] for e in cap['audit']['xray_events'] if e['eventName']=='PutTelemetryRecords'}
cap['audit']['telemetry_correlated_labels']=[telemetry_ids[rid] for rid in telemetry_ids if rid in logged]
cap['audit']['telemetry_labels_not_observed_in_window']=[o['label'] for o in cap['observations'] if o['operation']=='put-telemetry-records' and o['result']['request_id'] not in logged and o['request_started_ms']<=cap['audit']['complete_window_end_ms']]
cap['audit']['telemetry_labels_after_audit_window']=[o['label'] for o in cap['observations'] if o['operation']=='put-telemetry-records' and o['request_started_ms']>cap['audit']['complete_window_end_ms']]
cap['evidence_boundaries'].append('Fresh replayable STS session workflow was captured after trail cleanup. Its allow/deny wire observations are not claimed to have new audit delivery. Original request-correlated role allow/deny events remain in unsequenced_session_evidence because their original AssumeRole calls lacked request timing metadata.')
cap['finalization_source']={'filename':Path(__file__).name,'language':'python','content':Path(__file__).read_text(),'invocation':['python3',str(Path(__file__))]}
text=json.dumps(cap,indent=2)+'\n'
assert not re.search(r'(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}',text)
path.write_text(text)
print(json.dumps({'observations':len(cap['observations']),'telemetry_calls':len(telemetry_ids),'telemetry_audit_events':len(logged),'xray_audit_events':len(cap['audit']['xray_events']),'cleanup_complete':cap['cleanup_verification']['verified_complete'],'prior_cleanup_complete':cap['prior_runs'][0]['cleanup_verification']['verified_complete']}))
